test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Feb 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the letter cluster that can replace the (?) in the following series.

DKM, FJP, HIS, JHV, ?
solution:
According to the English alphabet and its positional values: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2279b560b10991887192eff3a548e57e9b0820d787d416555b032b86f014a220.png] 

The pattern followed by the given series is:

 
• **The First alphabet is increased to 2 positional values.**
 
• The Second alphabet is decreased to 1 positional value.
 
• The third alphabet is increased to 3 positional values.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/54c48ad404d35d68b4f19cacd585771f282d8dfef66f848cf30143b6bb50100a.png] 

Hence **the correct answer is option 3).**
